summary: Backend-only testing for PROPOSTA JÁ API. Created pytest suite covering auth (register/login/me), company profile (GET/PUT with logo_base64), proposals CRUD, status transitions (aberto→realizado, perdido with/without reason), stats aggregation, clients aggregation and 401 unauthorized checks. All 22 tests passed (100%) against the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.

minor.issue: Email is silently lowercased server-side; response reflects lowercased email even if user typed mixed-case. Not a bug, just behavior worth noting for frontend display.
When status is 'aberto' or 'realizado', any provided lost_reason is silently cleared (overwritten to ''). Expected per UX but worth confirming.

action_items: Frontend was NOT tested (testing_type=backend only). Main agent should run a UI pass before final sign-off.
Consider adding response_model Pydantic classes to /api/proposals/* endpoints to guarantee shape (currently returns dicts).

Expo logs show minor version mismatch warnings (expo-file-system, expo-image-picker, expo-notifications, expo-print, expo-secure-store, expo-sharing). Not blocking for backend testing but may affect mobile runtime.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 395 lines and well-structured; no split needed yet but keep an eye as proposals/clients logic grows.
JWT_SECRET, MONGO_URL, DB_NAME correctly read from env with KeyError-on-missing (fail-fast). Good.
MongoDB _id is consistently excluded via {'_id': 0} projections and .pop('_id', None) - safe.

CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] WITH allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject credentialed requests. Since this app uses Bearer tokens (no cookies), it works, but for hygiene either drop allow_credentials or use explicit origins.
Password hashing uses bcrypt (good). JWT uses HS256 with 30-day expiry (acceptable for MVP).
get_current_user strips 'password_hash' via projection — verified in test_me_returns_user.
Perdido status validation correctly returns 400 when lost_reason is missing/whitespace.
seed_data_creation: Each test-module run registers a fresh user with a randomized TEST_ email (e.g. test_<uuid>@propostaja.com). Proposals created during the run are deleted in the cleanup tests. No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints all confirmed working end-to-end via public URL. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_proposta_ja_api.py for regression. If frontend testing is requested next, focus on: login/register screens, create-proposal flow (new.tsx), status change flow with 'perdido' reason modal, WhatsApp share link formatting, logo upload (expo-image-picker) in profile.tsx, and PDF generation via expo-print.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found during backend testing.
